image_description: A close-up view of a black, box-shaped loudspeaker enclosure. The front face features a large circular driver (woofer) with a white cone and a prominent black dust cap in the center. Above the main driver, a portion of a smaller driver (tweeter or mid-range) is visible. There are mounting screws at the corners of the driver frame. A small sticker with text/logos is present on the upper left corner of the baffle.

The texture of the white cone is somewhat uniform and lacks the fine fibrous detail often seen in high-resolution photos of paper cones, appearing slightly 'plastic' or digitally smoothed.
